title: Persistent e with authored placement, user movement and no Hide
statement: User explicitly requested an orchestrated place for e, user movement and no hiding. Implemented the shared React portal with authored page contexts, bounded dragging/keyboard movement, remembered manual placement, return-to-place, Pause and an authored conversation panel whose closure leaves e visible. Added static-page embed composition and a quicker 14.2-second film retaining the full slow-smoke window.
conditions: Latest user direction supersedes earlier Hide/Restore proposals.
Conversation is authored guidance; no LLM connection or external submission added.
Manual placement and Pause persist per origin; message history is per document.
Published knowledge resolves c027ef8, 15/15 selected sources read, no diagnostics; historical packet is older.
